_meta.purpose: Tamil wording for IRUSHY's local engine. Same keys and the same {slots} as phrasebook.en.json. 'frames' have 2-4 variants picked with a seed made from the request; 'fixed' entries are single texts.
_meta.status: awaiting review by a Tamil-medium teacher
style: Sentences end with the verb (or a nominal predicate), as in standard written Tamil.
Respect forms throughout: நீங்கள், -ங்கள் imperatives (பாருங்கள், கேளுங்கள்); never the informal நீ.

English technical terms stay in English (RAM, CPU, SQL, binary), with the Tamil term in brackets where Tamil-medium books use one, as in data/sample/glossary.sample.json. The teacher's own wording always wins.
{topic} and {term} slots are placed only before case-free words (பற்றி, தொடர்பான, என்ற, என்பது), so no case suffix is ever glued to an inserted English or Tamil title.
